en.headline: Hong Kong Tourism Board runs Gourmet Month with more than 400 restaurants through November
en.dek: The campaign offers limited-time menus and late-night deals at hundreds of outlets after the Wine and Dine Festival, including Michelin-starred venues.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board is running Hong Kong Gourmet Month throughout November, with more than 400 restaurants, bars and food outlets offering limited-time menus and promotions.

The initiative follows the annual Wine and Dine Festival and includes a late-night dining guide covering nearly 100 venues that offer deals after 9pm. Some outlets in popular districts will stay open later.

Participating places range from Michelin-starred restaurants to regional eateries and bars. The board said the campaign aims to highlight the city's food scene from daytime to late night for both residents and visitors.
Details of participating venues and offers are available through the Tourism Board's channels. The programme runs until the end of the month.

zh.headline: 旅發局推出香港美食月 逾400間食肆至月底提供限定菜單
zh.dek: 活動在美酒佳餚巡禮後舉行，涵蓋米芝蓮星級餐廳至地區食肆，並設深夜飲食指南，部分商戶延長營業時間。
body: 香港旅遊發展局於整個11月推行「香港美食月」，超過400間餐廳、酒吧及餐飲場所提供限定菜單及推廣。
活動緊接年度美酒佳餚巡禮，包括一個深夜飲食指南，涵蓋近100間在晚上9時後提供優惠的場所。部分熱門地區的商戶會延長營業至午夜或更晚。
參與場地從米芝蓮星級餐廳到地區特色食肆及酒吧不等。旅發局表示，活動旨在讓市民及旅客從日間到深夜體驗本港飲食文化。
有關參與商戶及優惠詳情可透過旅發局渠道查閱。活動持續至本月底。
